crombolo import

Replace this site with a whole-site file; says what first. Each run acts again.

crombolo import <file> [--replace] [--replace-all] [--yes] [--allow-missing-media] [--backup-taken]
ArgumentWhat it is
fileA whole-site file (crombolo export --site). Required.
--replaceReplace this site: what it loses is recycled, people kept.
--replace-allMake it exactly the file: what it loses is deleted, people too.
--yesWith --replace-all: don't ask.
--allow-missing-mediaImport media items whose files the file does not carry.
--backup-takenA backup was taken another way: Postgres needs this, or CROMBOLO_PG_DUMP.

crombolo import umbraco apply

Write a crombolo site from an Umbraco backup. Each run acts again.

crombolo import umbraco apply <backup> [--site <site>] [--media <media>] [--name <name>] [--drafts] [--staging <staging>] [--with-members] [--with-users] [--include-content] [--allow-content-unencrypted] --out <out> [--postgres] [--force]
ArgumentWhat it is
backupA .bacpac, or Umbraco's SQLite file. Required.
--siteThe Umbraco site's files, for its views, media and plugins.
--mediaWhere its media files are, if not under --site.
--nameThe new site's name.
--draftsBring drafts too.
--stagingWhere to unpack a .bacpac.
--with-membersBring members, encrypted.
--with-usersBring back-office users, encrypted.
--include-contentBring property values and media files, encrypted under a passphrase.
--allow-content-unencryptedWith --include-content: write them readable.
--outThe site directory to write. Required.
--postgresConfigure Postgres.
--forceWrite into a directory that is not empty.

crombolo import umbraco report

Read-only: what importing an Umbraco backup would bring, and what it would not. Changes nothing.

crombolo import umbraco report <backup> [--site <site>] [--media <media>] [--name <name>] [--drafts] [--staging <staging>] [--with-members] [--with-users] [--include-content] [--allow-content-unencrypted] [--out <out>]
ArgumentWhat it is
backupA .bacpac, or Umbraco's SQLite file. Required.
--siteThe Umbraco site's files, for its views, media and plugins.
--mediaWhere its media files are, if not under --site.
--nameThe new site's name.
--draftsBring drafts too.
--stagingWhere to unpack a .bacpac.
--with-membersBring members, encrypted.
--with-usersBring back-office users, encrypted.
--include-contentBring property values and media files, encrypted under a passphrase.
--allow-content-unencryptedWith --include-content: write them readable.
--outAlso write report.md and report.json here.
